svg.title: TrnRT at a glance
svg.desc: Throughput: 3.57M tokens per minute, one trn2.48xlarge on AgentX, batch 12; Decode Step: 24 ms at 8 concurrent users, down from 34 ms with NKI megakernels; Cost: $0.040 per million tokens, spot price; $0.167 on a capacity block
